==Ingredients==

=== Soup ===
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]] dried [[Cookbook:Black Bean|black beans]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:Vegetable Oil|vegetable oil]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Onion|large onions]], [[Cookbook:Dice|finely diced]]
* 4–6 [[Cookbook:Garlic|cloves garlic]], [[Cookbook:Mince|minced]]
* 6 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] [[Cookbook:Water|cold water]]
* 1 cup peeled, seeded, and [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]] [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomato]] (fresh or canned)
* 1 small sprig fresh or dried [[Cookbook:Epazote|epazote]] (optional)
* 1 tablespoon finely-chopped canned [[Cookbook:Chipotle Pepper|chipotle chile]] (or ¼ teaspoon [[Cookbook:Cayenne Pepper|cayenne pepper]] or to taste)
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Cumin|ground cumin seed]]
* 1 teaspoon [[Cookbook:Coriander|ground coriander]]
* 2 teaspoons [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]

=== Salsa ===
* 1 large tomato, finely diced
* 3 medium [[Cookbook:Tomatillo|tomatillos]], husks removed and finely diced
* 1 small red onion, very finely diced
* 1 serrano or [[Cookbook:Jalapeño|jalapeño]] [[Cookbook:Chiles|chile]], very finely diced
* ¼ cup roughly-[[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]] fresh [[Cookbook:Cilantro|cilantro leaves]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]], to taste
* [[Cookbook:Crème Fraiche|Crème fraîche]] or [[Cookbook:Sour Cream|sour cream]], for [[Cookbook:Garnish|garnish]]

==Procedure==

=== Soup ===
# Pick over the beans to remove any debris. Soak if desired and drain.
# In a deep, heavy-based pot, heat oil over medium heat.
# Add onions and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
# Add beans, garlic and water.
# Bring to a [[Cookbook:Boil|boil]], skimming any foam that rises to the surface.
# Reduce to a [[Cookbook:simmer|simmer]] and when the beans are soft, after about 1 hour, add tomato, epazote, chipotle chile, cumin, coriander and salt.
# Cook until the beans start to break down and broth begins to thicken.
# Taste for seasoning; add salt and pepper if needed.

=== Salsa ===
# In a small bowl, combine tomato, tomatillo, onion, jalapeño and cilantro.
# Taste for seasoning and add salt as needed.

=== Serving ===
# Ladle soup into individual serving bowls.
# Garnish each with a spoonful of crème fraîche and salsa.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* If you're serving this soup immediately, you can thicken it by [[Cookbook:Puree|pureeing]] a cup or two of the beans in a [[Cookbook:Blender|blender]] or [[Cookbook:Food Processor|food processor]] and then recombining them with the rest of the soup. If refrigerated overnight, the soup will thicken on its own.
* The salsa will taste best if assembled no more than an hour before serving.
* Epazote is an herb that looks like a weed and is regularly used in Mexican cooking. If you can't find it, use an equal amount of cilantro.
* Tomatillos look like rock hard tomatoes with papery skin. Look for them canned in the Hispanic section of your market, if you can't find fresh. They will be perfectly acceptable.
* Crème fraîche is similar to sour cream, but richer. Look for it in the fancy cheese section.
